writeup: TIC 258316486 is a candidate eclipsing binary star with an orbital period of 7.5230 days. TESS photometry reveals a primary eclipse with a depth of 16.87 percent dimming, detected with a signal-to-noise ratio of 160.9 using box-least-squares analysis. Pixel-level image analysis confirms a centroid offset of 1.7 arcsec from the target position, with a peak signal-to-noise of 33.3 in difference imaging. No secondary eclipse was detected in the available data. This candidate does not appear in six major variable-star catalogs, suggesting it has not been previously cataloged. The pipeline's machine learning model assigned this target a screening score of 0.39 on a scale from 0 to 1, reflecting moderate confidence in its reality as a stellar system.
